# Vhome

> Vhome (vhome.ge) is a real estate marketplace in Georgia where buyers and renters can explore properties in Tbilisi and Batumi through immersive 3D tours, including Gaussian-splat walkthroughs, alongside map search and trusted local agents.

## Preferred languages
- Georgian (ka) — default URLs, no prefix
- English (en) — `/en/…`
- Russian (ru) — `/ru/…`
- hreflang is published on every public page

## Main pages
- Home / search: https://vhome.ge/
- Map search: https://vhome.ge/map
- 3D tours hub: https://vhome.ge/3d-tours
- Agents directory: https://vhome.ge/agents
- Architecture services: https://vhome.ge/services
- About: https://vhome.ge/about
- FAQ: https://vhome.ge/faq
- Contact: https://vhome.ge/contact
- Privacy: https://vhome.ge/privacy
- Terms: https://vhome.ge/terms
- Sitemap: https://vhome.ge/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://vhome.ge/robots.txt
- This file: https://vhome.ge/llms.txt

## City and district hubs (crawlable, unique copy)
- https://vhome.ge/tbilisi
- https://vhome.ge/tbilisi/apartments-for-sale
- https://vhome.ge/tbilisi/apartments-for-rent
- https://vhome.ge/tbilisi/saburtalo/apartments-for-sale
- https://vhome.ge/tbilisi/vake/apartments-for-sale
- https://vhome.ge/batumi
- https://vhome.ge/batumi/apartments-for-sale
- Same pattern for Kutaisi, Rustavi, Mtskheta, Gori
- English/Russian: prefix `/en` or `/ru` (e.g. https://vhome.ge/en/tbilisi/apartments-for-sale)

## What the product does
- Public search for sale, rent and mortgage listings across Georgia
- Filters: property type, price, area, rooms, city/district, land status, amenities, has-3D
- Property detail pages with photos, optional 360/VR/Gaussian-splat tours, price and contact
- Agent profiles with portfolio listings
- Structured data: Organization, WebSite, RealEstateListing, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage, ItemList, VideoObject (tours)

## Listings
- URL pattern: https://vhome.ge/property/{id}
- Fields typically include: title, description, price (USD/GEL), sqm, rooms, address, city, deal type, photos, tour links
- HTML is server-rendered (H1, description, specs, photos with alt, agent, tour)

## Agents
- Directory: https://vhome.ge/agents
- Profile: https://vhome.ge/agents/{id}

## 3D tours / Gaussian Splatting
- Hub: https://vhome.ge/3d-tours
- A listing may include an interactive 3DGS walkthrough, a 360° panorama, or both
- Filter: homepage / map “Has 3D”, or the hub gallery

## FAQ topics covered on /faq
- What is Vhome
- How to find apartments/houses in Tbilisi
- What VR/3D / Gaussian-splat tours are
- How to find agents
- Price currency (USD/GEL)
- Agricultural vs non-agricultural land
- Contacting listing owners

## Machine-readable API (public read)
- Properties list (paginated, default 40, max 5000): https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/properties?page=1&limit=40
- Single property: https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/properties/{id}
- Agents list: https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/agents
- Optional query: `?lang=ka|en|ru` for translated title/city/street/description
- Public responses omit internal fields (moderation history, drafts, deletion records, owner-only notes)
